text: The 'systems reply' to the Chinese Room contends that:
choices: The room could never behave as though it understands Chinese
Although the person doesn't understand Chinese, the whole system (person + rulebook + symbol store) does
Only a robot with sensorimotor links to the world could understand
Simulating each neuron of a Chinese speaker's brain would yield understanding
explanation: The systems reply grants that the person doesn't understand Chinese but holds that the whole system (person, rulebook, and symbol store together) does. Option 2 is the distinct robot reply (sensorimotor grounding) and option 3 is the brain-simulator reply; option 0 denies the behavioural premise the thought experiment stipulates.
